question_text: A child is brought into the emergency room by her mother. Her mother states that the 7-year-old child was playing with their dog, who is up to date on his vaccinations. When the dog started playing more aggressively, the child suffered a bite on the hand with two puncture wounds from the dog's canines. The child is up-to-date on her vaccinations and has no medical history. Her vitals are within normal limits. If this bite becomes infected, what is the most likely organism to be the cause of infection?
